name: check_sound_durations
description: Parses a sound-list markdown table and verifies every discrete feedback cue is under 800 ms; returns per-row pass/fail and a summary.

markdown.description: audio-spec markdown text containing rows like | id | trigger | ... | duration_ms | kind |

example.markdown:
| seed_pickup | pinch seed from tray | 180 ms | feedback |
| grow_swell | hold open palm 4 s | 4000 ms | state |
| moth_flutter | loop while flying | loop ms | state |
